introduction_markdown:
**Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), June 2020. Duration: two and a half hours. Do ALL the tasks (Task 1, Task 2 and Task 3) specified in the question paper.**

The booklet reproduced here contains three versions of the same practical paper, headed Group One, Group Two and Group Three. Each version has three tasks: Task 1 (word processing, 20 marks), Task 2 (spreadsheet, 20 marks) and Task 3 (reading and running a short C or Pascal program, 10 marks).

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The working files named in the tasks (the pictures 'foxandstork' and 'hareandtortoise' found on the desktop) are supplied on the day; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.

questions.enonce_markdown: Create a workbook called Task 2 and key in the data as provided.  *[4 marks]*
Format the worksheet data as follows: a. Bold and use a font size of 14 for the title.  *[1 mark]*
b. Bold and use a font size of 12 for the column headers.  *[1 mark]*
c. Bold, center and use italic font in all cells with grades.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: Select the grades **D3:J12**, then in the *Home* tab click **B** (Bold, *Ctrl + B*), **Center** (*Ctrl + E*) and **I** (Italic, *Ctrl + I*).

questions.enonce_markdown: d. Merge cells A1 to J1 and center the title.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: Select **A1:J1** and click **Merge & Center** (*Home* tab, *Alignment* group).

questions.enonce_markdown: Given that the pass grades are A, B and C: a. Add three more columns headers to the right of Column J with headers SubjectsSat, SubjectsPassed, and AGrades.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: The data end in column J (CTZ), so type the new headers in **K2** (`SubjectsSat`), **L2** (`SubjectsPassed`) and **M2** (`AGrades`) and give them the same format as the other headers (bold, size 12).

questions.enonce_markdown: b. Use suitable spreadsheet functions to calculate the number of subjects sat, subjects passed and A grades earned for the first student Ngemoussi Juliette.  *[6 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Ngemoussi Juliette is in row 3 and her grades are in D3:J3 (seven subjects: Eng, Fre, Mat, His, Geo, Econs, CTZ).

- **Subjects sat**, in **K3**: `=COUNTA(D3:J3)`. `COUNTA` counts the non-empty cells, so an empty cell (subject not sat) is not counted. Result: **7**.
- **Subjects passed**, in **L3**: `=COUNTIF(D3:J3,"A")+COUNTIF(D3:J3,"B")+COUNTIF(D3:J3,"C")`. Each `COUNTIF` counts the cells equal to one pass grade, and the three counts are added. Her grades are B, D, C, D, A, B, D, so she has B, C, A, B = **4** passes.
- **A grades**, in **M3**: `=COUNTIF(D3:J3,"A")`. Result: **1** (Geo).

(The formulas were checked with a Python simulation on the grades of Figure 2.)

questions.enonce_markdown: Write in the space below, the formula typed in cells K3, L3 and M3.  *[3 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
- **K3**: `=COUNTA(D3:J3)`
- **L3**: `=COUNTIF(D3:J3,"A")+COUNTIF(D3:J3,"B")+COUNTIF(D3:J3,"C")`
- **M3**: `=COUNTIF(D3:J3,"A")`

Each formula starts with `=`, refers to the range **D3:J3** of the first student and, for the grades, writes the letters between double quotation marks. One mark per correct formula.
